_comment: Branch-protection payload for the FUL repo default branch. Origin: FUL-23 task 1; merge-policy resolved in FUL-34; running posture RATIFIED by Security in FUL-35 (the authority for required_approving_review_count=0); IaC reconciled to live in FUL-36. Apply with ops/apply-branch-protection.sh (token needs repo-admin). NOTES: (1) required_status_checks.contexts must be the CHECK-RUN/job name 'baileys-sidecar-gate' alone, NOT 'baileys-sidecar-ci / baileys-sidecar-gate' (the 'workflow / job' form is unsatisfiable and made main permanently unmergeable). (2) required_approving_review_count is 0 because this is a single-GitHub-identity company (darshjme), who authors PRs and cannot self-approve; with 1 required review no agent could ever merge (the FUL-34 outage). (3) IMPORTANT CAVEAT (verified FUL-36): while count=0, require_code_owner_reviews is INERT — GitHub enforces code-owner approval ONLY when count>=1. So today the CODEOWNERS gate provides NO actual review enforcement; the ONLY enforced merge control is the required status check 'baileys-sidecar-gate'. Real code-owner enforcement requires count>=1, which is unachievable without a SECOND reviewer identity (Security bot/account). Raise count to 1 only once that second identity exists.
